title: Figure 8: BOMARC and Talos ramjet-assisted missiles (Boeing / U.S. Navy photos)
description: Two color photographs side by side: at left a BOMARC missile marked "USAF" launching vertically with exhaust plume; at right a Talos missile on a shipboard launcher rail. Caption: "Figure 8. BOMARC (left) and Talos (right) Ramjet-Assisted Missiles (courtesy Boeing and the U.S. Navy)." Appears in a report discussing positron-powered propulsion and a single-stage reusable vehicle (SSRV).
